title: Catalogue discovered third-party job sources
acceptance_oracle: With synthetic profile data, manually captured jobs and externally reported applications that include a third-party URL create a durable profile-scoped source candidate and provenance observation. Reading the source queue after reload shows the reported origin separately from the destination, sanitized links, explicit unknown hops, review state/reason and site type. Replays do not duplicate observations; cross-profile reads/reviews do not disclose or mutate another profile's candidate. Capture and review make no outbound requests and never enable collection or represent an application as submitted.

capture_paths: Manual job capture records candidates from user-supplied reference/application URLs.
External application recording records candidates from user-supplied source/destination URLs, including retry readback.
Candidate capture is profile-scoped, hostname normalized, tenant/subdomain preserving, and request-id idempotent.
URL query/fragment and URL userinfo are excluded; known sensitive path values are redacted. Reported origin remains user-reported and distinct from destination.
Candidate review stores append-only reason, state, and site-type assessment history. Integration is never asserted by capture/review; collection stays disabled.
Malformed hop metadata is represented as one explicit UNKNOWN value.
implementation.remaining_scope: PARTIAL: supported provider/browser discovery entry points are not all connected; candidate evaluation still needs documented API/feed/access evidence, capabilities/limits/maintenance-cost records, and a bounded integration task/provider-issue link. No collector is implemented or enabled, and no live TalentHop/source inspection was attempted. Missing job metadata is supported when existing capture supplies a URL, but the existing external-application contract still requires company/title. Issue #517 remains OPEN; no broad acceptance is claimed.

frontend.build_result: TypeScript check and Vite production build PASS

commands: inspect source_candidates, source_candidate_observations, source_candidate_reviews and review-history site_type schema
migration.result: SQLite migration upgrade and schema assertions PASS; empty-database downgrade PASS; Alembic has one head at bc517d01a320

validation.browser_and_network_scope: Chromium browser acceptance used fixture profile data, loopback API/UI and an isolated SQLite database. A local-only route guard observed no external browser requests; a local HTTP probe received no source URL request. Capture, review, reload, profile isolation and collection-disabled behavior passed.
validation.database_environment: Disposable SQLite migration and synthetic persistence were run. PostgreSQL and Docker runtime checks were not run.
validation.hosted_checks: NOT_RUN_BY_USER_POLICY; GitHub Actions and hosted reviewers remain disabled.

evidence_privacy: Only synthetic profile, employer, job, URL and browser data were used. No private resume, credentials, cookies, application database, or raw private logs are included.
